'''Fey'starn''' was a small fishing village located on the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] homeworld of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]].<ref name="COG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
There is some discrepancy as to whether Fey'starn is situated on Bothawui or on the colony world of [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]].<ref name="COG" />
